title: 場

sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L237-S01 lesson image for a Taiwan preschool Traditional Chinese character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. A simple market fish shop or fish stall scene with a distinct fish-shop seller showing several fresh fish. Protagonist little girl and protagonist mother look at the fish and feel that this shop's fish are not expensive.
Visual cast: protagonist little girl from L154/L162/L163 family continuity, wearing pink jacket, white shirt, blue skirt, pink shoes, small pink hair clip. Protagonist mother from L154/L162/L163 family continuity, shoulder-length dark hair, white or beige top and wide blue pants. Fish-shop seller is a separate shopkeeper role, clearly different face, hair, body shape, and clothes from protagonist mother and from any teacher; use a practical apron and different hairstyle. L058 is style reference only, not a character reference.
Composition: center the fish display, seller, protagonist mother, and protagonist little girl; keep fish large and readable in a phone square crop; safe margins.
Style: refined warm watercolor children's textbook illustration, soft transparent colors, delicate colored-pencil linework, friendly Taiwan daily-life feeling.
Avoid: no price lists, written text, numbers, signs, shop names, labels, zhuyin, brands, logos, watermarks, readable marks, price tags, or labels on fish or clothes.
sentences.imageNotes: 市場魚店或魚攤場景，魚店賣魚的人展示幾條魚，主角小女孩和主角媽媽看著魚，感覺這家店賣的魚不貴。魚店賣魚的人是清楚的店家角色，不能長得像主角媽媽或老師。不可有價目表、文字、數字、招牌、品牌或標籤。

sentences.text: 一場大雨過後，地上有水。
sentences.spokenText: 一場大雨過後地上有水
sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L237-S04 lesson image for a Taiwan preschool Traditional Chinese character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. Outdoor scene just after a heavy rain: visible puddles on the ground, wet grass or leaves, clouds breaking apart. Protagonist little girl stands safely to the side looking at water on the ground without stepping into deep water.
Visual cast: protagonist little girl from L154/L162/L163 family continuity, pink jacket, white shirt, blue skirt, pink shoes, small pink hair clip. L058 is style reference only, not a character reference.
Composition: center the safe puddles and protagonist little girl, keep ground water clearly visible, show rain has passed; safe margins for square mobile preview.
Style: refined warm watercolor children's textbook illustration, soft post-rain light, gentle and not gloomy.
Avoid: no written text, numbers, street signs, shop signs, labels, zhuyin, logos, watermarks, readable marks, license plates, or danger scenes.
sentences.imageNotes: 大雨剛停後的戶外場景，地上有明顯積水，天空雲散開，路邊樹葉或草地濕濕的。可有主角小女孩站在安全處看著地上的水，但不要讓她踩進深水。畫面要清楚呈現「一場大雨過後，地上有水」。不可有文字、數字、招牌或標籤。

sentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩和主角媽媽在眼鏡店或家裡看一副眼鏡，小女孩需要或想買眼鏡，但主角媽媽看著手上的錢，表示眼鏡太貴，錢不夠買。畫面要清楚呈現「眼鏡太貴，錢不夠買」。眼鏡、錢、桌面和背景不可有文字、數字、價格、品牌或標籤。
